PLAN "12-Week Couch to 5K Plan"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary endurance:
    name "5K goal in 12 weeks"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Intro to easy running":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 1x1.0k rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          jog 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Walk-to-run progression":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x1.0k rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 30m "Run focus with strides":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 2x0.5k rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 32m "Progressive easy runs":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 1x1.2k rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          jog 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 32m "Walk/run mix":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x1.4k rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 32m "Strides + easy":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 2x0.6k rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Aerobic base":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 1x1.6k rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          jog 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Run/walk intervals":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 2x0.8k rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 35m "Progression":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 1x2.0k rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          jog 5 minutes
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 36m "Transition to continuous":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 1x2.2k rpe 5–6
        rest 120 seconds
        rpe 5
        (note: keep consistent)
      DAY Wednesday training 34m "Easy repeater":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 2x1.0k rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 34m "End of phase test":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 1x2.4k rpe 5
        cooldown:
          jog 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Base building with longer runs":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 2x1.6k rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          jog 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Steady state":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 1x3.0k rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          jog 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 40m "Bursty finish":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 2x1.8k rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          jog 5 minutes
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 42m "Tempo curiosity":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 1x2.2k rpe 5.5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          jog 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Edge build":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 2x2.0k rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 42m "Light progression":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 2x1.2k rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          jog 5 minutes
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 44m "Longer easy runs":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 1x3.0k rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          jog 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 42m "Steady mix":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 2x2.4k rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 44m "Fartlek light":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 3x1.0k rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 46m "Race prep intro":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 1x3.6k rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          jog 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 44m "Aerobic mix":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 2x2.6k rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 46m "Light steady":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 2x1.8k rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 48m "Peak endurance build":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 2x3.0k rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          jog 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 46m "Tempo run":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x4.0k rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 48m "Recovery and drills":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 2x2.0k rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progression mix":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 1x2.0k rpe 5
          run 1x3.0k rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          jog 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 48m "Steady state":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 2x3.2k rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 50m "Longer easy run":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 2x2.6k rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          jog 5 minutes
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 52m "Race pace prep":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 2x3.6k rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          jog 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Final tune-up":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          run 1x4.2k rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Friday training 52m "Easy shakeout":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 2x2.0k rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 42m "Taper start":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 1x3.0k rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          jog 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Taper continue":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 1x2.0k rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
      DAY Saturday training 40m "5K readiness cue":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          jog 1x5.0k rpe 5 rest 180 seconds
        cooldown:
          jog 5 minutes

Notes:
- RPE guidance corresponds to exertion during each run; adjust pace to maintain comfortable conversational effort, especially with asthma.
- Always carry rescue inhaler as advised; include a warm, humid environment and avoid sudden cold-air exposure.
- If intolerance occurs, switch to a walk/run pattern with shorter run bouts and longer walking recovery.
